address: Jalan Teluk Datai, 07000 Pulau Langkawi, Kedah Darul Aman, Malaysia
tagline: Kerry Hill's rainforest resort above Datai Bay, opened in 1993.
description:
The Datai Langkawi stands on the northwestern tip of Pulau Langkawi, set back from Datai Bay in rainforest. Architect Kerry Hill placed the main building on a ridge 40 metres above sea level and 300 metres back from the beach. The resort opened in 1993. It received the Aga Khan Award for Architecture in 2001. A renovation in 2017 and 2018, the largest since opening, was led by Didier Lefort of DL2A, who had worked with Hill on the original scheme. The resort prints its position as GPS N 06 25.411, E 99 40.216. Langkawi International Airport is a 40-minute drive, and Kuah, the main town, is 20 kilometres to the east.

Rooms and villas are grouped in three collections. In the main building, 35 Canopy Deluxe rooms, five Canopy Garden rooms and 14 Canopy Premium rooms are each 63 square metres. Eleven Canopy Suites run from 109 to 125 square metres, and The Datai Suite is 258 square metres. In the forest, a Rainforest Villa and seven Rainforest Premium Villas are 123 square metres on stilts, the premium villas looking onto the Anak Datai River. The Rainforest Pool Villa is 175 square metres with a 7.6-metre pool. The Datai Estate Villa is 3,500 square metres with five bedrooms. On the sand, 13 one-bedroom beach villas of 350 square metres and one two-bedroom beach villa of 750 square metres have private pools and 24-hour butler service.

The Gulai House, in a Malay kampung house in the forest, serves Malaysian cooking, with floor seating in the bersila manner. The Pavilion stands on 30-metre stilts and serves Thai food at night. The Dining Room, level with the main pool, serves breakfast and lunch, and in fruiting season great hornbills feed on a strangling fig beside it. The Beach Club and Beach Bar serve pizza, the catch of the day and grilled seafood. The Lobby Lounge looks over the Andaman Sea and Tarutao.

Three pools serve the resort. The Adult Pool, for guests aged 16 and over, sits at the main building. The Family Pool, near the beach, includes a toddler pool. The spa has five treatment villas and uses Ramuan, the Malay tradition of plants and herbs, with VOYA skincare and Bastien Gonzalez nail treatments. Opening hours are 10:00 to 21:00. Dusky langurs, tokay geckos and Sunda colugos are the animals the resort names in the forest around Datai Bay.

The Datai suits travellers who want a rainforest stay a short drive from the airport, with a beach villa or a room in the ridge building, and several kitchens between the trees and the sand.
